close_reason:
Stale — subsumed by bd:JMAP-ayoz.9 (closed 2026-05-17, commit f2eb26c).

The bead critiqued the four-representation walk inside the old filter_changes_array helper (Value::String → String → Id → String → Value::String per id). That helper was removed in the JMAP-ayoz.9 refactor; the post-fix code at metadata.rs:175-247 has a cleaner shape:

- Vec<String> for the raw response arrays (line 188-203).
- Dedup via &str-borrowing HashSet, with Id::from called only on unique ids destined for the backend call (line 209-215).
- Single get_objects round-trip (line 218-221).
- HashMap<String, &Metadata> lookup built once (line 224-227).
- New filter_array_via_lookup helper (memory.rs:312-358) consumes the Vec<String> directly against the &HashMap; no per-array re-fetch.

The bead's recommended rewrite was substantively what JMAP-ayoz.9 landed (single union get_objects, filter both arrays from one lookup). The 'Id allocation is throwaway' critique no longer applies because the Id construction now feeds the dedup-output channel into the single backend call. Closing as already-done.
title: metadata.rs filter_changes_array's id-Rust gymnastics is harder to read than necessary
